fixture_adaptation: Join the two distinct rank-0 batch sequences as [0|1, 1|0] along the token axis.
input_generation: Native QKV/conv and hidden, replayed FLA scan, seeded FP8 gate weight, captured dV as output cotangent; isolated VJP uses native FP8 o_proj dgrad.
projection_weight_origin: Reused the verified crop's seeded FP8 o_proj with matching dimensions.

measurement.control: Second execution of the baseline at the same inputs.
measurement.event_span_us: Single-stream CUDA event elapsed span, including possible host submission gaps.
measurement.host_call_us: Python/autograd/allocator and launch submission until the call returns.
measurement.host_wait_us: End-event record plus host blocking wait.
measurement.wall_us: Call, end-event record, and blocking wait together.
measurement.profile: Separate warmed CPU/CUDA trace with kernel, idle gap, and copy/memset times on one stream. No distributed communication.
measurement.memory: Allocated/reserved peaks after an allocator cache flush and stats reset; includes output buffers until synchronization.
